subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] mm/mempolicy: stop copying the nodemask in the interleave paths

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch removes the unnecessary copying of a nodemask in interleave node selectors to improve performance and reduce memory usage. The original copy was intended to prevent division by zero and overrunning the allocation request buffer, but it did not correct distribution accuracy during rebinds. Instead, the patch introduces bounds checking for the walk and relies on the nodelist access being racy but safe. It also removes an unused function and reduces stack usage in three functions.
